params.caption: 🎮 GTA 6 takes "Easter eggs" literally Players exploring GTA 6's open world found a bird's nest on top of a cell tower holding painted Easter eggs. Jason can pick one up and throw it with a tight spiral, sending it flying across the city, as shown in a clip shared by player xGarbett on X.
